start_value = 1459.5
end_value = 2106.4

print(f'Start value (FY 1947): {start_value}')
print(f'End value (FY 1950): {end_value}')
print(f'Number of years: {n}')
print(f'CAGR: {cagr}')
print(f'CAGR as percent: {cagr_percent:.6f}%')
print(f'Rounded to nearest thousandth: {cagr_percent:.3f}%')
